analysis: Descriptive fixed-study reporting, with every restart retained; no parameter tuning or outcome filtering.

hamiltonian_uniqueness.definition: Exact indexed Hamiltonian identity: qubit count, energy denominator, constant, fields and couplings; scheduling mapping and provenance identities excluded. No qubit-permutation equivalence reduction.
hamiltonian_uniqueness.interpretation: Every frozen reference and restart is retained. Evaluation has 19 references but only 17 distinct indexed Hamiltonians; these are not 19 independent quantum optimization problems.

interpretation_limits: Tiny, structurally selected synthetic instances; ideal classical simulation; depth comparisons use paired instance restart-medians. Size and encoding features are confounded. No generalization, causality or quantum advantage is inferred.

exploratory_correlations.analysis: exploratory associations; no causal interpretation or confirmatory hypothesis
exploratory_correlations.unit_of_analysis: one restart-median per instance/p, stratified by split and p
exploratory_correlations.warning: Small structurally selected synthetic suite; features are confounded and instances recur across depths. Correlations are unstable and cannot establish generalization.
